cash_breakdown.item: Cash and cash equivalents outside PRC financial institutions
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group cash outside the specifically disclosed PRC financial-institution balance is closer to offshore or non-PRC unrestricted cash, but exact holding-entity split is not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included in cash and cash equivalents; annual report separately discloses RMB80.532 million placed in PRC financial institutions.

cash_breakdown.item: Cash and cash equivalents placed in PRC financial institutions
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC remittance restrictions are explicitly disclosed and parent/subsidiary distribution path is not proven; use a conservative ordinary PRC subsidiary cash haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially usable by the PRC operating business or through dividends, but not assumed fully movable to the HK listed parent.

cash_breakdown.item: Pledged bank deposits securing RMB bank borrowings
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Included only as a paired gross item because the matching secured bank debt is deducted in full; the economics are viewed net of the RMB82.0 million secured borrowing.
cash_breakdown.reason: Fixed-rate pledged deposits are not freely distributable before settlement of the paired bank borrowing.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed securities are liquid but price volatility is material and RMB69.916 million is pledged to secure broker payables.
cash_breakdown.reason: HK and US listed equity securities can be sold in principle, but pledged part must be considered together with the broker liability.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The notes are secured and an early redemption notice was received after year-end, but the instrument is a Cayman SPV tokenised note and not ordinary cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Treated as a potentially recoverable financial asset with a material liquidity and execution haircut.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unlisted minority stakes in newly established PRC companies that had not commenced substantive business operations; exit path and valuation are uncertain.
cash_breakdown.reason: Only a small residual value is counted in the detachable pool.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All interest-bearing borrowings are repayable within one year and are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Includes third-party, former fellow subsidiary and bank borrowings; RMB82.0 million secured bank loans are matched against pledged bank deposits.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Broker payable secured by pledged listed equity securities is a financing-like claim and is deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Prevents counting pledged listed securities without the matching broker liability.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Large 2025 hardware trading scale, RMB482.770 million contract liabilities, RMB471.793 million supplier prepayments and RMB279.572 million inventories require a working cash buffer.
cash_breakdown.reason: Estimated conservatively because annual report does not identify excess cash by legal entity or by customer-advance obligations.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve for PRC remittance, tax, FX and distribution friction when extracting subsidiary cash or liquidating financial assets.
cash_breakdown.reason: The report discloses PRC cash remittance restrictions and multi-jurisdiction structure.

profit_quality.assessment: Low-to-medium confidence. 2025 reported parent net profit was RMB152.186 million, but the group also recognised RMB72.112 million FVTPL fair value gains and RMB64.585 million share of associate results. Operating cash flow was negative in 2023 and 2024 and only RMB43.677 million positive in 2025 despite a large increase in customer advances, supplier prepayments and inventories.
adjustments: Use RMB55.0 million as the pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit, anchored to 2025 recurring operating earnings after removing material FVTPL and associate gains and considering tax/NCI leakage.

Apply a 0.40 cash profit haircut because recent reported profit has not consistently converted into free cash and the 2025 hardware expansion consumed large receivables, supplier prepayments and inventories.
Do not add back investment gains or associate profits to the main operating denominator.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow: 2025 RMB43.677 million, 2024 negative RMB65.638 million, 2023 negative RMB12.608 million. Capital expenditure proxy: 2025 PPE acquisitions RMB0.654 million plus intangible payments RMB7.567 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Profit denominator is reduced for investment-gain reliance, associate earnings, negative prior-year operating cash flow and substantial working-capital dependence.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak: 2025 operating cash flow divided by parent net profit was about 0.287, while 2024 and 2023 operating cash flow was negative.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No separate maintenance capex disclosure; current-year PPE acquisitions plus intangible payments total RMB8.221 million and are used as the capex evidence point.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 revenue growth was accompanied by inventories rising to RMB279.572 million, supplier prepayments to RMB471.793 million and contract liabilities to RMB482.770 million, indicating cash is tied to execution of hardware/product orders.

limitations: Market cap uses rough screening input and was not independently repriced.
Cash is not fully split by legal entity; PRC remittance restriction is disclosed only for RMB80.532 million.
Necessary operating cash is estimated because the annual report does not map cash balances to customer advances and purchase obligations.
Profit denominator depends on a conservative recurring/cash conversion adjustment because 2025 business scale changed sharply and investment gains were material.
